svg.title: Three geodesics from one point with one velocity
svg.desc: On the Gaussian half-plane the geodesics of the e-connection, the m-connection and the Levi-Civita connection leave (mu, sigma) = (1, 2) with the same velocity (1, 0.5) and arrive at different points at t = 1. The speed in the Fisher metric grows along the e-geodesic, falls along the m-geodesic and is constant along the Levi-Civita geodesic.
svg.text: Same start, same velocity, three connections
dots mark t = 1: e at (3.00, 2.83), m at (2.00, 2.24), Levi-Civita at (2.23, 2.39)
